visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium shot of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige knitted turtleneck sweater, holding a large red and gold lottery card featuring snake illustrations and "2000" text. She is indoors with a light-colored couch and a dark bag behind her, under bright, even lighting. (2) The woman places the lottery card on a round brown wooden table. She holds a pink scratching tool with a steel wool head and vigorously rubs the card's surface. Silver scratch-off residue begins to accumulate on the table surface. A male figure in a black hoodie is partially visible sitting behind her. (3) Close-up shot focusing on the woman's hands and the pink tool as she rapidly scratches multiple sections of the lottery card. The motion is repetitive and forceful, causing silver shavings to scatter across the table and her white pants. (4) The woman holds the scratched lottery card up to the camera, then uses a smartphone to scan a QR code on the back. She looks at the phone screen with an expectant expression while sitting in a domestic living room environment. (5) A sequence of shots showing the woman scratching through a fan-out pile of lottery cards. Her facial expressions vary from excitement to intense concentration. The pile of used cards on the table increases as she works through them. (6) The woman holds up her right palm toward the camera, pointing to a small red mark or scrape. She looks frustrated. The wooden table is now covered in a thick layer of silver residue and discarded red tickets. (7) Final shot of the woman sitting cross-legged on the floor, surrounded by the mess of scratch-off shavings. She holds her hands out in a gesture of helplessness, looking at the camera with a mix of amusement and exhaustion. Her white pants are visibly dusted with silver residue.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaking Traditional Chinese with a bright, energetic tone. High-pitched and fast-paced. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 synth beat is constant in the background. (2) A loud, abrasive, high-frequency rhythmic scratching sound (resembling sandpaper on stiff cardboard) dominates the acoustic space. The female speaker's voice remains highly active, occasionally accompanied by a male voice with a lower pitch and calm delivery. (3) The intensity and speed of the scratching SFX increase significantly. The female voice exhibits high pitch variability and frequent bursts of laughter. Short paper-rustling transients occur as cards are shifted. BGM maintains its upbeat energy. (4) The scratching sound pauses briefly. The female voice adopts a slightly lower arousal, narrative tone, while still sounding friendly. Digital 'ding' sounds and short synthesized UI blips are layered in post-production. (5) Resume of the rapid, rhythmic scratching sound. The female voice sounds slightly more breathless and strained from the physical effort. The male voice laughs in the background. Sounds of lottery cards being slapped onto the wooden table produce low-frequency thuds. (6) The female voice becomes more exaggerated and melodramatic. The volume of her speech increases, punctuating the intermittent scratching SFX. (7) Final vocal segment with the female speaker expressing exhaustion. Her speech rate slows and includes a long sigh. The BGM fades out with a slight reverb tail. A final 'whoosh' transition sound marks the end.
